command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===BOUNDARY==='
echo 'machine_id=ai-core-node'
echo 'owner=gabriel'
echo 'execution_boundary=REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED'
echo '===REPO==='
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
echo 'STATUS:'; git status --porcelain=v1 | head -80 || true
echo '===TARGETED_INGRESS_MATCHES==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo')
terms=(
    '_f2wp1207_turn_loop_auto', 'run_canonical_turn', 'typed_entry',
    'signal_overrides', 'chatgpt_senden', 'chatgpt_ernten',
    'provider_id', 'model_id', 'organ_route', 'route_digest'
)
roots=[root/'scripts', root/'DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH'/'repository'/'scripts']
seen=set(); matches=[]
for base in roots:
    if not base.exists(): continue
    for p in base.rglob('*.py'):
        if p in seen: continue
        seen.add(p)
        try:
            if p.stat().st_size > 6_000_000: continue
            lines=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()
        except Exception:
            continue
        for i,line in enumerate(lines):
            if any(t in line for t in terms):
                matches.append((p,i,lines))
for p,i,lines in matches[:120]:
    rel=p.relative_to(root)
    print(f'--- {rel}:{i+1} ---')
    for j in range(max(0,i-3),min(len(lines),i+5)):
        print(f'{j+1:06d}: {lines[j]}')
print(f'MATCH_COUNT={len(matches)} PRINTED={min(len(matches),120)}')
PY
